load.title: Computation load
load.heading: Computation time of the latest epoch ({{days}} days)
load.noData: No data yet. Run an epoch to see how long the latest epoch took to compute.
load.note: When several epochs run in a row, this shows the last one. Problem size is a rough estimate of the main comparisons, based on the size of the city.
load.workloadHint: Rough number of main comparisons (array elements). Hover over a value to see the breakdown.

workload.market: Buyers {{demanders}} × sellers {{suppliers}} (multiplied per product and summed)
workload.realestate: Households considering a move {{movers}} × residential buildings {{housing}}
workload.building_spawn: Candidate parcels {{parcels}} × building types × floor counts × floor uses
workload.routing: 2 travel modes × zones {{zones}} × zones {{zones}} × 3 candidate routes × paths {{paths}}

memory.title: Memory
memory.note: Physical memory used by the simulator process. The peak includes temporary increases during epochs.

approximation.title: Simulation approximation
approximation.intro: Options to simplify calculations for large cities are planned. These settings cannot be changed yet.
approximation.warning: These changes may affect game balance. They cannot be undone.
approximation.irreversible: Changes caused by approximation persist in later epochs. Once enabled, approximation cannot be disabled or reduced.

goods.label: Purchase candidates
goods.description: Limit the suppliers compared by price and distance.

jobs.label: Job candidates
jobs.description: Limit the employers compared by wages and commuting conditions.

housing.label: Housing candidates
housing.description: Limit the homes compared by rent and location.

interval.label: Routine decision interval
interval.description: Review shopping, job and housing choices less often.

aggregation.label: Group similar citizens and households
aggregation.description: Make some decisions collectively for citizens or households with similar circumstances.
